name: Hiactor
listed_description: Newer actor framework for C++ from Alibaba, named as an alternative to CAF.
reason: No numbers anywhere reachable. README (2,969 bytes) and docs/tutorial.md describe a Seastar-based distributed actor framework and say only 'high-performance, concurrent and scalable event-driven systems'; repo has no benchmark or example performance directory (cmake, codegen, demos, docs, include, seastar, src, tests); one WebSearch found no Hiactor vs CAF or Seastar comparison. Last commit 2024-06-14, Apache-2.0, 119 stars.
